26OCT 2026
Latest listed release

GPU efficiency and mission fixes

Memory compression restored, corrected MetalFX output resolution, and a new 40 FPS limit.

Performance

  • Less GPU work per frame: GPU memory compression, disabled during an earlier test, is enabled again. According to the release notes, an iPhone 13 Pro used about a sixth less GPU work per frame, with uncapped performance increasing from approximately 43 to 52 FPS. A 30 or 40 FPS cap should have more headroom and may run cooler.
  • MetalFX: upscales to the screen’s actual resolution instead of beyond it, reducing GPU work and some memory use.
  • 40 FPS frame limit: a new option between 30 and 45 FPS, smoothest on 120 Hz screens.

Fixes

  • The Merryweather Heist: fixes a black screen or frozen camera after the freighter explodes on 4 GB devices.
  • By the Book: tooth pulling now works with touch. The right stick also appears under the left thumb, with a new Auto rotate button.
  • Leftover debug logging removed.

How to update

  • Sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Game data and saves stay.
  • Mac: the new GTAV-mac.zip includes the same fixes.
  • New, or skipped 18 Oct? Set up GTAV_patch and movies.zip from the 22 Oct download once.
  • 4 GB devices: start with the lowest preset, Battery Saver.

Reporting problems

Send the whole GTA V › Logs folder, or ~/Library/Logs/GTA5 on Mac, and identify the 26 Oct build. The GPU change has only been tested on an iPhone 13 Pro. If colours look wrong or blocky patches appear, include a screenshot.

Download via Discord
25OCT 2026
Previous release

Mac preview and expanded input support

Apple silicon Mac testing, keyboard and mouse controls, Self Radio, and a larger trainer.

New features

  • Mac preview: first test for Apple silicon Macs (M1 or later) on macOS 14+. Download GTAV-mac.zip and follow its README. It uses the same GTAV folder as the mobile version.
  • Keyboard and mouse: PC controls on iPhone and iPad. On iPad, the pointer locks to the game. Touch controls hide while these inputs are in use; tap the screen to show them again. This is new and needs feedback.
  • Self Radio: import MP3, M4A, FLAC, WAV, and other supported audio through Launcher › Settings › Audio › Import, then tune to Self Radio.
  • Background audio: Spotify and Apple Music can keep playing. Choose Audio › Stop It to restore the previous behavior.
  • Settings sharing: Launcher › Settings › Import / Export shares graphics settings as a file or text.
  • Trainer: 311 vehicles organized by class, with search, plus 150 interior teleport locations. Planes spawn in the air.
  • Controller support: navigate the launcher and trainer. Use View in the pause menu to open the trainer.
  • A12 devices: experimental support for iPhone XS / XR and iPad Pro 2018 / 2020, with DirectX 10 selected automatically.
  • Full Screen: larger weapon and radio wheels.

Fixes

  • The game keeps running through calls, timers, alarms, Siri, and Spotify interruptions; audio returns afterward.
  • Fixed crashes in The Bureau Raid and other scripted movies when movies.zip is missing.
  • Taxis used with trainer skins should charge the original story character, resolving free rides and an unwanted wanted level.
  • Fixed a rare physics crash.

How to update

  1. Sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Existing game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup from the 22 October download. Follow its README.
  3. 4 GB devices: begin with Battery Saver, the lowest preset.

Report a problem

  • Send the complete GTA V › Logs folder and identify the 25 October build. On Mac, logs are in ~/Library/Logs/GTA5.

24OCT 2026EVENING
Test build

A12 support and controller testing

An evening test build adds an experimental A12 graphics path and controller navigation.

Experimental build. A12 support and controller behavior need further testing.

New features

  • One IPA: the test build includes A12 devices alongside newer devices.
  • Experimental A12 support: iPhone XS / XS Max / XR, iPad Pro 2018 / 2020 (A12X / A12Z), and A12 iPads receive a dedicated graphics path with DirectX 10 selected automatically. The release notes report one A12Z iPad running without visual glitches. Rendering on newer devices stays the same.
  • Launcher controller navigation: use the d-pad or stick to move, A to select, B to go back, LB / RB to change tabs, and Menu to play.
  • Trainer controller navigation: press View in the pause menu. Use A / B, LB / RB to jump sections, and Left / Right to change switches.
  • Full Screen: larger weapon and radio wheels.

Fixes

  • Taxis used with trainer skins should charge the story character instead of producing a free ride and wanted level. Further testing is requested.
  • Fixed a rare physics crash observed on an A12Z iPad.
  • Includes the changes from the 24 October daytime build.

How to update

  1. Sign and install GTAV-unsigned-24Oct-evening.ipa. Game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup from the 22 October download. Follow its README.
  3. 4 GB: use Battery Saver initially, including XS / XS Max and most 2018 iPad Pro models.
  4. 3 GB: memory is likely insufficient on XR and A12 iPad Air / mini / iPad 8.

Report a problem

  • Send the complete GTA V › Logs folder, device model, and iOS version. Identify the 24 October evening test build.

24OCT 2026
Release

Trainer and full graphics settings

Full Screen vertical mode, expanded launcher settings, and a preview of the Mods tab.

New features

  • Vertical Mode › Full Screen: fills the upright display, places the minimap at the top left, and shows menus in a central band. Dual Screen retains the previous layout.
  • Trainer: open it from the pause menu for god mode, wanted level, money, teleports, 112 vehicles, 53 skins, weapons, time, weather, world switches, and PC cheat codes.
  • Graphics settings: the launcher now includes every graphics option from the pause menu, plus an Advanced Graphics page.
  • Cutscene Depth of Field: disable it in Launcher › HUD & Controls to keep shots sharp.
  • Presets: adjusted per chip, from A13 to M-series.
  • Mods preview: the Mods tab lists files in GTA V › GTAV › mods. Functional mod support is planned for a later release.

Fixes

  • Cheats selected while paused now apply correctly.
  • Cutscene close-ups retain shadows at Normal shadow quality.
  • Fixed a crash when switching pause-menu tabs in Full Screen.
  • Restored stars, cash, and ammunition to the top-right corner in Full Screen, and adjusted the phone to fit.
  • Includes the 23 October changes, including frame pacing and the reload-crash fix.

How to update

  1. Sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup from the 22 October download. Follow its README.

23OCT 2026
Release

Frame pacing and launcher refinements

More consistent frame delivery, an expanded vertical layout, and corrected resolution options.

New features

  • Vertical mode: a solid minimap panel and a special-ability bar beneath armour. Vertical mode is also available on iPad for the first time; feedback is requested.
  • Cutscene Black Bars: disable them in Launcher › HUD & Controls to fill the display.
  • Resolution: launcher options and presets match the game’s own sizes. The launcher also has a new logo.
  • Aspect ratio: iPhones start at 19.5:9. Existing Auto settings switch once.
  • Steering: arrow controls remain visible while driving with the phone open.
  • Pause menu: removed the Online, Friends, and Store tabs.

Fixes

  • Fixed reload crashes with Luxury / Etched Ammu-Nation finishes on assault rifles, carbines, special carbines, and sniper rifles. If a finish-specific magazine is missing from the phone data, the standard magazine is used.
  • Frame pacing: 30 and 60 FPS targets synchronize with the screen, avoiding periodically held frames and uneven input delay.
  • Includes the 22 October builds’ changes, including Game Mode, the saves page, the river fix, and vertical mode.

How to update

  1. Sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup from the 22 October download. Follow its README.

22OCT 2026
Release

Vertical mode and save imports

A new portrait layout, save imports, touch-based web navigation, and additional frame limits.

New features

  • Experimental vertical mode on iPhone: Settings › HUD & Controls › Vertical Mode places the game above a larger minimap and a panel for the clock, wanted stars, health, armour, and weapon. Controls sit below and use a separate layout.
  • Exit Game: returns to the launcher. Continue resumes play; Quit the game closes it.
  • Import saves: Launcher › Data › Import Save accepts an SGTA5… file from a PC or another device. Choose a slot; overwritten saves are kept in Replaced saves.
  • In-game internet: tap to click, drag or flick to scroll, and use Back / Close / Up / Down controls.
  • Frame limiter: 90 and 120 FPS options on 120 Hz screens with VSync Off.
  • First-start brightness: added touch buttons.

Fixes

  • Removed the dark blue text-filled screen at startup.
  • Corrected touch positions in internet pages and menus at 16:9 resolutions.
  • Fixed a crash in Nervous Ron.

Touch controls

  • The phone’s X button displays its current action, such as Reply, Enter No., or Delete, and hides when unused.
  • Prompted buttons such as Hide Menu show an icon and a word instead of a colored letter.
  • Shared layouts include the vertical layout.

How to update

  1. If the 18 October setup is complete, sign and install GTAV-oct22.ipa. Game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup described in the README.

Report a problem

  • Send the complete GTA V › Logs folder and identify the 22 October build.

21OCT 2026
Release

Memory stability and touch layout sharing

Story-money fixes, memory-aware presets, and improvements to touch controls.

Fixes

  • Story money no longer resets to $0 after loading, Wasted, or Busted. Cheat money and cash pickups count correctly.
  • Fixed getting stuck at the entrance of a purchased garage.
  • Mission markers and race checkpoints no longer appear as solid walls on DirectX 10.
  • Multi Target Assassination allows 18 minutes instead of 9 to account for travel with touch controls.
  • Presets and memory budgets follow the memory iOS makes available to the app, which depends on signing, rather than installed RAM. Settings that exceed the budget are reduced at startup.
  • Frame Limiter Off can reach up to 120 FPS on ProMotion displays instead of stopping at 60.

Touch controls

  • Yoga: Auto pose holds both sticks in position. Hold LT + RT to breathe in and release to breathe out.
  • The right stick appears only in minigames that need it, including By the Book, yoga, and tattooing. LS Customs and shops retain camera controls.
  • Gas and Brake remain visible while using the phone in a car. Throttle / Down remain visible when flying.
  • The phone gains an X button for its left soft key.
  • Edit layouts through Launcher › Settings › HUD & Controls › Edit.
  • Share exports layouts as a file or text; Import loads them. Both are also available in the pause menu’s Edit controls.

Settings

  • DirectX 11 becomes the default. Existing DirectX 10 settings switch once, with an option to switch back.
  • Removed Original BC Textures on M-series iPads because it caused broken textures.

How to update

  1. If the 18 October setup is complete, sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Game data and saves remain.
  2. New installations, or builds that skipped 18 October, also need the one-time GTAV_patch and movies.zip setup in the README.

Report a problem

  • Send the complete GTA V › Logs folder and identify the 21 October build.

20OCT 2026
Release

Phone camera and improved diagnostics

Camera-crash fixes, full-width photos, and logs that retain the previous session.

Fixes and improvements

  • Taking a photo with the in-game phone no longer crashes the game. Photos save to the gallery.
  • iPhone photos display the complete image instead of a narrow image between black bars.
  • Crash, freeze, and unexpected-exit reports include more context: the error, location, mission, and memory. The previous session is saved as run.prev.log, so a restart does not erase it.

How to update

  1. If the 18 October setup is complete, sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Game data and saves remain. Do not copy GTAV_patch again.
  2. Otherwise, copy GTAV_patch into On My iPhone › GTA V, alongside GTAV. The next launch applies and removes the patch.
  3. The patch expects the 16 October data, whose update/update2.rpf is 277.8 MB in Files. If the data does not match, delete GTAV_patch and send the Logs folder.
  4. Unzip movies.zip (84 MB) in Files, then move its movies folder into GTA V › GTAV. TVs and screens require this step.

Report a problem

  • Send the complete GTA V › Logs folder, including crash-*.txt, run.log, and run.prev.log. Describe what you were doing and identify the 20 October build.

18OCT 2026
Release

TV playback and required data patch

Working TV screens, mission-loading fixes, and a one-time patch and movies setup.

This update requires a one-time data patch and movies setup, in addition to installing the IPA.

New features and fixes

  • TV playback: TV channels, the Lifeinvader presentation in Lester’s mission, and screens in cutscenes now work.
  • Fixed freezes and endless loading around Paleto Bay and Trevor’s Friends Reunited. This requires the one-time fix patch.
  • Fixed the crash after upgrading weapons at Ammu-Nation.
  • Vehicle controls: Weapons (X) cycles weapons with repeated taps; Duck (A) is available. Passengers also receive Weapons.
  • Sniper zoom: pinch with two fingers.
  • Weapon wheel on foot: Previous / Next cycles weapons within the same slot.
  • New defaults: Fullscreen and VSync Off replace Windowed and VSync Half, which capped the game at 30 FPS. Existing settings switch once; both options are available in the launcher.
  • A cleaner FPS counter.

How to update

  1. Sign and install the new GTAV-unsigned.ipa. Existing game data and saves remain.
  2. Copy GTAV_patch into On My iPhone › GTA V, alongside GTAV, not inside it. The next launch applies and removes the patch.
  3. The patch expects the 16 October data, whose update/update2.rpf is 277.8 MB in Files. If the data does not match, delete GTAV_patch and send run.log.
  4. Unzip movies.zip (84 MB) in Files and move its movies folder into GTA V › GTAV. This is required for TVs and screens.

Report a problem

  • Send crash-*.txt and run.log from GTA V › Logs, and include your build date.

17OCT 2026
First release

Expanded iOS support and responsive controls

The first release brings prompt-aware buttons, cheats, and A13 support.

Touch controls

  • Buttons follow the game’s help text and bottom-right prompts, using the game’s own labels. Existing buttons gain a blue ring and a label. This addresses taxi A / B menus, LS Customs and shops, the Lifeinvader TV, and Retry / Skip after mission failure.
  • New layouts for passengers / taxis and shop or script menus, including d-pad and Select / Back.
  • Vehicle controls include Raise / Lower for tow trucks, forklifts, and dock handlers; Ascend / Dive in submarines; weapon switching on armed vehicles; and cinematic camera (B) in cars, aircraft, and bikes. Aircraft also receive Radio / Weapon and Hook / Bomb bay.
  • Detonate is available on foot for sticky bombs and grenades.
  • Steer cars, motorcycles, and bicycles with a floating stick or large left / right buttons. Choose in Launcher › HUD & Controls or Edit controls.
  • Each layout includes a custom button whose input can be assigned in Edit controls.
  • Extra pause-menu buttons display their names, including Y = Hide Menu. Removed the nonfunctional Social Club button.

Cheats

  • The pause menu’s Cheats button includes all 34 PC cheat codes plus god mode, never wanted, infinite ammo, teleport to waypoint, vehicle repair, clear wanted level, +$100,000, and noon / midnight.
  • Cheats apply when play resumes. Some missions block cheats, and achievements are disabled for that session, as on PC.

Devices and memory

  • One IPA targets iOS 16.3+ (previously iOS 18) and A13 devices, including iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and SE (2nd generation). The release headline describes iPhone 11 or newer.
  • A13 rendering omits corona glints and bokeh depth of field. Other visuals are expected to remain the same.
  • The IPA requests the increased memory limit. Preserve its entitlements when signing with AltStore, SideStore, or Sideloadly.

Testing status

  • iOS 16, iOS 17, and iPhone 11 had not yet been tested for this release. If launch fails, send Documents/Logs/run.log from Files › On My iPhone › GTA V.

How to update

  1. Sign and install the IPA again.
  2. Original 17 October release files ↗
